integrity.mathematical_basis: Conditional response identity and Walsh orthogonality plus finite incidence argument

limitations: Only one synchronous update from a fair independent input measure is proved; no mixing-time or nonfair-stationary-measure classification is asserted.
The n=3 exceptional stationary line is already implicit in Muñoz--Nuño (2026).
Historical priority against unidentified higher-order stochastic cellular automaton identities remains a risk.
Finite exact rational tests support but do not replace the all-size proof.
title: Third-order Bernoulli mimicry and a fourth-order obstruction in a noisy majority automaton
